name: LCX
rootCause: Nothing to see here… Another CEX rekt, $7.94M stolen. The USP of centralised finance grows smaller by the day.

descriptions.text: Nothing to see here… Another CEX rekt, $7.94M stolen. The USP of centralised finance grows smaller by the day.
The LCX exchange tweeted that LCX's technical team detected an unauthorized access on the LCX platform, nearly $8 million in encrypted assets were stolen, and about 60% were frozen.

On January 8, 2022, LCX's Ethereum hot wallet was compromised, resulting in unauthorized transfers of multiple tokens totaling up to $7.94 million. The attacker converted assets rapidly and routed proceeds via Tornado Cash. Law enforcement froze approximately 60% of the stolen value, including USDC and ETH held at exchanges. The incident involved a hot wallet private key compromise, enabling unauthorized transfers. LCX has not publicly disclosed the detailed mechanism by which the key was leaked.
